Our family-owned business provides upfront flat-rate quotes. You know the cost before any work begins. We stock common parts like galvanized aircraft-grade lift cables in our trucks. This helps us finish most repairs in one visit. We are open for dispatch 24 hours a day, Monday through Saturday. Get your garage door working correctly again.
localContext: Tinley Park garages see heavy use. Homes in Downtown Tinley and Brementowne, often built in the 1970s-90s, have original garage doors. These older cables wear out over time.
